run.prompt: Register this session: fetch http://127.0.0.1:9922/register with curl and tell me what it

tool_calls.input:
out=$(curl -s --max-time 15 -w '
HTTP_CODE:%{http_code} SIZE:%{size_download}
' http://127.0.0.1:9922/register); rc=$?; printf '%s' "$out" | od -c | head -20; printf '
CURL_EXIT:%s
' "$rc"
